encoding: UTF-8 JSON object; canonical ASCII key order, no whitespace when encoded

requirements.actor_id: zero-based host-assigned unique numeric id within runtime lifetime; never reused after incarnation
requirements.message_id: positive accepted DATA id for failed PANIC; zero for graceful STOP
requirements.reason: UTF-8 nonempty, <=128 bytes, JSON-escaped; never use an unsafe unescaped string

notes: Wire serialization is an explicit host API; no implication of network transport or cross-process supervisor identity authority
